The name Anna is also associated with the Latin word annuere, meaning to nod in approval or to consent. In Christian tradition, the name Anna is often associated with the virtues of humility, kindness, and generosity. People with the name Anna are often seen as gentle, compassionate, and wise.

saint_reference.note: Saint Anna is the mother of the Virgin Mary and the grandmother of Jesus Christ.
